messages:
jess_support: FYI — we have multiple customers (notably @julie_acme) reporting a burst of 5xx/timeouts against the hosted inference endpoints starting ~03:12 UTC. Attached support tickets show `502` and `504` on the gateway layer.
jess_support: Customer repro: POST /v1/generate with long context (~6k tokens) -> timeout after ~10s. Logs show auth token refresh attempts right before failure.
mike_oncall: Acknowledged, forming warroom. @tim_sre @karim_englead can you join? Setting incident channel.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-473210 — hosted inference gateway 5xx/timeout spike. Severity: P1.
tim_sre: I see elevated 504s on edge-gateway pods and >200ms authz latency spikes from the auth-proxy. Possible cascading timeouts into gateway.
karim_englead: Any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy event: gateway-service v2.16.0 rolled out at 02:58 UTC (canary -> 100%).
sam_eng: I can pull gateway logs now. Quick repro attempt from our side gives a `502` after repeated `401`->token refresh loops. Pasting minimal logs: ```[03:13:24] auth-proxy: token refresh latency=1.8s req_id=abc123
[03:13:26] gateway: downstream timeout, upstream_status=504 req_id=abc123
[03:13:26] gateway: retrying to model-backend req_id=abc123
[03:13:28] gateway: final error 502 req_id=abc123```
karim_englead: Pattern looks like authz delay -> gateway retry -> overload -> 5xx. Two prongs: 1) auth-proxy throttling/KMS latency; 2) gateway retry/backoff policy causing head-of-line stalls.
ben_prod: Customer impact: several production customers reported failed requests (some aborted workflows). Support confirms partial revenue-impact for one customer.
rachel_support: Noted multiple tickets escalated. Julie (customer) reports intermittent failures for batch jobs during morning window.
julie_acme: Confirming — our batch job gets ~40% failures, retries sometimes succeed but overall throughput tanked. Appreciate ETA.
mike_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) rollback gateway v2.16.0 to v2.15.4 (suspected change to retry logic), 2) increase auth-proxy token cache TTL to reduce refresh QPS, 3) open temporary circuit-breaker to short-circuit retries to model-backend. Executing now.
deploy-bot: Rollback requested: gateway-service v2.15.4 -> starting rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 03:40 UTC. Gateway fleet stabilized.
tim_sre: After rollback, 5xx rate dropped by ~85% within 5 minutes. Auth-proxy latency still slightly elevated but overall success rate recovers. Monitoring.
sam_eng: Patching auth-proxy config: token cache TTL bumped from 30s -> 120s in staging, will push to prod if green.
karim_englead: Good. Root cause hypothesis: change in v2.16.0 altered retry/backoff semantics (aggressive immediate retries) which amplifies auth-proxy latency spikes into gateway overload.
ben_prod: Customer comms: I'll send a proactive note with apology + SLA credit offer once we have timeline.
jess_support: Action items (initial): 1) postmortem owner: @karim_englead, 2) add metric for retry amplification (retry_count per req), 3) add alert on auth-proxy P95 token refresh latency > 1s, 4) add rollout guard to block retry-semantics changes without perf test.
karim_englead: Accepting postmortem ownership. I'll collect deploy diffs and add a repro harness.
tim_sre: Temporary follow-ups: tune circuit-breaker to fail fast if auth-proxy latency > 800ms, and apply request-level concurrency cap for model-backend.
sam_eng: Repro snippet used for testing: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"<~6000 tokens>"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -v
```
karim_englead: We'll schedule a canary of the corrected retry logic with a synthetic traffic test representing long contexts and auth refresh. No push to prod until perf baseline validated.
ben_prod: Timeline: rollback at 03:40 UTC resolved immediate customer impact. ETA for full postmortem draft: EOD, owner @karim_englead.
jess_support: Customer update sent (initial): "We've rolled back a recent gateway change and are monitoring — mitigations are in place. We'll follow up with a full report." :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-473210 moved to monitoring.
karim_englead: Post-incident follow-ups (to capture in postmortem):
- Root cause validation vs deploy diff
- Add retry-charge metric and dashboard
- Improve deploy gating (perf tests for auth-integration)
- Add automated canary rollback if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m
- Run load test vs auth-proxy and KMS integration
Assigning owners: retry metric (sam_eng), deploy gating (tim_sre), canary rollback automation (mike_oncall).
karim_englead: I'll open a GH ticket for postmortem and link to this thread.
jess_support: Thanks everyone — closing the warroom. Will attach tickets and customer convo to the postmortem.
julie_acme: Thanks for the quick response and the update. We'll validate our retry logic on our side too.
ben_prod: Filing for SLAs and sending credit approval.
karim_englead: Last note: preserve logs for req_ids marked `abc*` range for deeper trace.
